notes: Held complete on the grid (8,389 train and 2,077 test DICOM of 4,000 and 1,000 studies), covered by WSU IRB HPR 2026-330 under the PhysioNet credentialed agreement. Layout from the PhysioNet page, read 2026-10-21 (#44): train_images/<image_id>.dicom, test_images/<image_id>.dicom, annotations/train.csv and test.csv with image_id, series_id, study_id (hashes of the DICOM UIDs), rad_id, lesion_type and a box. The person is the header's PatientID where it holds a value, else its StudyInstanceUID, so the identity level is the study wherever the release blanked the patient; the publisher's own train and test folders are both banked and the person hash splits them. The lesion boxes are not level labels and are not banked.
